recommended_actions: Block or rate-limit the source IP at the firewall, reverse proxy or application while you investigate.
If any sign-in from the IP succeeded, follow the runbook for PRH-AUTH-003.
For SSH, disable password authentication and allow keys only; restrict SSH to known networks.
Block the IP, or use a tool such as fail2ban to block repeat offenders automatically.
Disable password authentication and root login over SSH; allow keys only.
Restrict SSH to known networks or a VPN.
If a sign-in succeeded, follow the runbook for PRH-AUTH-003.
limitations: Enrichment not run: IP reputation and location were not considered
Single log source (sshd): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-001: Many users behind one shared NAT or proxy address
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-001: A script or password manager retrying a stale password
Possible benign cause for PRH-SSH-001: An automation tool configured with a wrong username
Possible benign cause for PRH-SSH-001: A user whose SSH agent offers many keys and hits MaxAuthTries on every connection
